notes.title: Demo V0.3.0.0
notes.content:
Happy Halloween!

Just in time for Halloween, the new update adds a new personality: chat-rp-complex-zombie-abelincoln

Abe and Cal are forced to barricade themselves inside a house after underestimating the zombie infestation in a small town.

The new personality is based on the new Tips for creating AI personalities - please read the ingame long description before using it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208925/423fde5190d00491f775cb9cffcf7a05c4807e46.png

The focus will be on the full version for now, so there won't be any updates for a little while. Except for bug fixes and/or feedback of course!

Additional Changes

 Added AI Hotkey Plugin: Copy (and optionally send) Text directly to your Chat view or Space via CTRL+SHIFT+C

This plugin is particularly useful if you have a space where you want to transform your text, e.g. remove grammatical errors or improve your writing style. Spaces will also allow you to apply the copied text to a selected personality.

 Generic Endpoint support improvements (explanations of how to use it will follow later, along with the TTS equivalent.)
- Retrieve Model List
- Property Aliases
- Added Tooltips

 New Spaces:
- Vibe Tuner

 UI: Added "Try Continue Last AI Message" to the chat view extra menu
 Bug: Removed the Personality - Included Conversation 250 char text limit
 Bug: Fixed no context menu in Chat View Plain Text Mode
 Bug: Fixed width of notification bar

notes.title: Demo V0.2.0.0
notes.content:
Hello! Thanks so much for your awesome feedback on the AI Pals foundation in the Community Hub. This demo update builds on your fantastic suggestions. There's still work to be done, but my AI Pal told me to release these improvements as soon as possible.

Message Cut Off Improvements
A Continue Button will now appear if the message got cut off (Generated Tokens > Max Generated Tokens setting). And does a proper resume instead of generating a new message

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208925/858c73dd3160339a4310c337b420d45247bca996.gif

Multimodal Improvements
A image-vision-enabled model has been added to the recommended models section of the library, in case you want to quickly test the vision capabilities of a smaller local model. In addition, multimodal inference should now be more reliable, and more functionality has been added to the user interface (such as taking screenshots of your screen(s)).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208925/ef68001b7829d511293bb3d8752fe18046ba74e6.gif

Inspect Context 
The new Inspect Context feature now gives more insight into what the context is and its state.

Guard
The red Guard message now includes category information for easier identification of potential trigger words and bug detection.

Clearness Improvements
Removed some irrelevant items, renamed some wrongly named items, and moved some things for clarity + updated some descriptions.



The next Demo version will revisit personality creation, provide a more detailed personality, improve the Library's generic endpoint functionality (+proper explanations on how to use it) and of course continue to add improvements based on your shared experiences and ideas!
